tasks.label: Create venv & install (llm_wrapper_project)
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path 'llm_wrapper_project\.venv')) { python -m venv llm_wrapper_project\.venv }; llm_wrapper_project\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade pip; llm_wrapper_project\.venv\Scripts\pip install -r llm_wrapper_project\requirements.txt
